desktop.note: Direct paired review of the m122b run frames (reviewer viewed both images): candidate renders the JP theme:include page, reference renders the EN theme:classic page, so page content and language differ by construction. Theme identity matches across the pair: black gradient header with white masthead and red tagline, sidebar structure with red links, centered emblem, red serif section headings, rating and credit module placement. The candidate top bar holds all five items on a single line with no wrap or overflow; the M113 containment holds on the bar. No actionable divergence.

laptop.note: Direct paired review of the m122b run frames: same JP/EN page-content difference as desktop by construction. Theme identity matches, candidate top bar fully contained on one line, sidebar and emblem treatment agree. No actionable divergence.
